title: Kissed Ethiopian Cherry Tomato Salad
description: A fresh and light Ethiopian dish featuring cherry tomatoes and nuka-pickle, served in an agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Rinse the cherry tomatoes and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a large bowl, combine the halved cherry tomatoes, chopped nuka-pickle, thinly sliced red onion, and chopped fresh cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the tomato mixture and toss to combine.
Spoon the salad onto the agave leaves, making sure to leave a small border around the edges.
Gently fold the agave leaves over the salad to form a packet, and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro, if desired.
Serve the Kissed Ethiopian Cherry Tomato Salad chilled, or at room temperature.
